facts.text: Andrew and his girlfriend volunteered at a pet shelter on Monday, which they found to be a rewarding experience.

evidence.quote: My GF and I just had a great experience volunteering at a pet shelter on Monday - it was so rewarding!

facts.text: Andrew expressed that spending time with the animals at the shelter made him realize how special and full of love they are.

evidence.quote: Seeing them so content makes me happy, it really makes me realize how special and full of love they are!

facts.text: Audrey has not volunteered at an animal shelter before but plans to do so in the future.

evidence.quote: I should do that someday too!

facts.text: Audrey has four dogs, whom she refers to as her 'fur babies,' and considers them more important than anything else.

evidence.quote: My four fur babies are more important to me than anything!
